about_the_game:
Slide and stretch your slime squadrons in daring raids against the Harpy Empire! Balance international opinion and the masses' clamoring for vengeance in a sky-spanning crusade to take back what is rightfully yours.


Raid the Harpies!

Slime Army High Command has identified roughly 10 major missions that requires your attention, and there is little time to waste.

Take the fight to the countless sky islands - some widely-known and well-mapped as strongholds of the Empire, while countless others are as ephemeral as the wind and seemingly as random.

Build up your Slime Squadrons

Strengthen your fire-team with exotic slime types, then genetically modify them with potent mutagens. Your troops have entrusted their very forms to you, to be forged into the ultimate harpy-slaying weapon. Utilize and sacrifice them as necessary - its what they were conscripted signed up for.


A Campaign of Vengeance

The slime race has been humiliated by the harpies' military ambitions, while human-dominated international media is far from sympathetic. Avenge your national pride and show the world that slimes are not pushovers.

And Remember...

name: Slime Squadron: Harpy Raiders

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8/8.1, 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel 3rd generation Core (Ivy Bridge) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce MX 350
  • Additional Notes: Game currently needs Vulkan capable graphics card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10

short_description: Stick, stretch, squish and slide your way as a squad of slime soldiers raiding the Harpy Empire in Slime Squadron: Harpy Raiders, an outlandish role-playing platformer. Maybe cause some humanitarian catastrophes along the way. Glory to the Slime Army!
